invValuation.title: Inventory valuation
invValuation.noWorkspace: Pick a workspace to see its inventory valuation.
invValuation.selectHint: Pick an item to see its valuation and its cost layers.
invValuation.lcmApplied: Lower of cost or market applied
invValuation.nrvHint: OR 960c: the selling value less the costs still to be incurred. Where it sits below cost it must be used.
invValuation.reasonHint: Required once movements exist from that date on: the reason is what the method history shows later.
invValuation.forceRevaluation: Confirm the revaluation of existing movements
invValuation.forceHint: Needed when movements already exist from the chosen date on. The change recalculates their valuation.
invValuation.effectiveFromHint: This date decides when the method starts to apply, and it is what TILL checks the period lock against. A year that is already closed cannot be revalued after the fact.
invValuation.noValuation: There is no valuation for this item at that date.

error.transport: The inventory valuation could not be loaded. Please try again.

empty.title: No stocked items yet
empty.hint: Create a stocked item and record some movements, then you can value it here.

methodDesc.weighted_average: Every receipt joins one cost pool, and what is on hand is valued at the average of it.
methodDesc.fifo: The oldest receipts are consumed first, so what is on hand carries the most recent purchase costs.
methodDesc.standard_cost: Stock is carried at a fixed standard price, and the gap to what was actually paid is reported as a variance.

history.title: Method history (consistency)
history.empty: No method has been recorded yet, so the weighted average applies.

reason.zero_quantity: Nothing on hand, so the value is zero.
reason.negative_quantity: On hand is negative. A short position carries no positive book value; fix the movements first.
reason.insufficient_layers: More was issued than ever arrived with a cost. The value rests only on the layers that existed.
reason.missing_standard_cost: Standard cost is in force but this item has no standard price.
reason.missing_unit_cost: None of the receipts carries a unit cost, so the value is zero.
reason.invalid_unit_cost: A movement carries a negative unit cost. TILL reports that rather than computing through it.
reason.invalid_net_realisable_value: The net realisable value must be a whole number of zero or more.

warning.missing_unit_cost: {qty} units arrived with no unit cost, so they are valued at zero rather than at the average of the rest. Movements affected:
warning.transfer_cost_ignored: A transfer carries a unit cost of its own. Valuation uses what the moved goods cost, not the stated figure: otherwise moving stock would change what it is worth.
warning.unpaired_transfer_leg: A transfer is missing its other half. TILL treats it as an ordinary movement and tells you, rather than inventing a counterparty.

errors.method_disabled: This method is not enabled for the workspace.
errors.method_is_default: This method is the current default. Change the default first, then you can disable it.
errors.method_change_blocked_open_period: The item already has movements from this date on, and the change would recalculate their valuation. Confirm the revaluation and state a reason.
errors.missing_standard_cost: Standard cost needs a standard price in Rappen.
errors.unknown_method: TILL does not know this valuation method.
errors.period_locked: That date sits in a closed period. A method cannot be back-dated into a year that is already closed.

explain.weightedAverage: Weighted average over every receipt up to the as-of date.
explain.fifo: FIFO: the oldest receipts have been consumed first.
explain.standardCost: Carried at standard cost, with the variance reported separately.
explain.lcm: The OR 960c lower-of-cost-or-market clamp was applied, layer by layer.
explain.allocated: A share of the item total, not valued on its own.
explain.locationNeedsAllocation: Under this method a location figure is a share of the item total, not something derived from that location's movements alone.
explain.zeroQuantity: Nothing on hand at the as-of date.
explain.negativeQuantity: Negative on hand, so no positive book value.
explain.insufficientLayers: More was issued than arrived with a cost.
explain.noCostBasis: No cost basis anywhere in the movements.
explain.invalidUnitCost: A movement carries a negative unit cost.
explain.invalidNrv: The net realisable value is not valid.

InventoryValuation.title: Inventory valuation
InventoryValuation.body: Here you choose the method your inventory is valued by and read the valuation that follows from it. The method list comes from the engine; a change takes effect from a date and stays traceable as history. Per item the valuation shows on-hand, unit cost and total value, at any as-of date if you wish; a lower market value can be recorded as a write-down. Nothing posts here: the valuation reaches the books through the valuation runs.
